decisions.statement: The shell scripts every build shares are the shell-script pages the ios-app page type names.
Every build shares every ios-component page and every ios-program page.
A page hands the build the files that page's properties carry.
A page's own TypeScript file is handed to no build.
A script the ios-app page type names and no page carries is refused.
A file is named from the repository root.

definition: the files of the pages every iOS app build compiles
